entry.title: New: dsh-taskboard
entry.summary: Full local-first issue board embedded in the DSH web GUI: Kanban / list / Gantt / workflow / dashboard views, AI chat per task, attachments and labels, auto-claim of todo tasks driven by dsh-routines — data lives in local SQLite (dsh plugin add @ttmouse/dsh-taskboard). Exact install spec: github:ttmouse/dsh-taskboard. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
